title: Winning the Game with Hypnosis: Examination of the Effectiveness of a Hypnosis Intervention in a Handball and Basketball Team
summary:
Previous studies have shown that hypnosis can enhance individual performance. For instance, professional downhill mountain bikers experienced reduced competition anxiety and increased resilience after hypnosis (Hoffmann, Strahler & Schmidt, 2024). Another study boosted participants' hand grip strength using post-hypnotic suggestions (Nieft, Schlütz & Schmidt, 2024).
In this study, we are testing hypnosis for entire teams: a professional women’s handball team (VFL Bad Schwartau) and a men’s basketball team (Niners Chemnitz). Both teams will play two games, with a hypnosis intervention in between. We will measure its effects using heart rate variability, grip strength, expert team performance ratings, and questionnaires.

interventions.name: Players of the handball team in Bad Schwartau and players of the basketball team in Chemnitz receive a hypnosis audio intervention between two games.
